confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Cape Town price levels; no live listings or booking pages were inspected. Restaurant and beer anchors are moderately confident. Accommodation anchors (hostel and 1-star) vary more by neighbourhood and season, and July is low season in Cape Town. Cocktail and wine_glass were set from the local price relationship to beer: cocktail at about twice the beer anchor and wine glass at about 1.3 times it, because direct knowledge of those prices is weaker. FX provenance: the rate was taken from search-result snippets and the RBA page was not opened directly. The snippets conflict (0.7002 for 14 October on the RBA homepage snippet, 0.6979 on a third-party site), so the RBA F11 table should be checked before relying on the figure.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against other mid-sized South African tourist cities and comparable Southern African urban destinations, adjusted for Cape Town's strong visitor demand and its mix of backpacker and mid-range hotel stock. Prices are holistic estimates, not from a named source.
